name: Stage 4: Bruce learns to see the ground
made_with: python main.py vision choose (each way of seeing's drive settings, on validation maps: 5 per theme, 2 trips each)

network.kind: U-Net (3 x 3 convolutions, ReLU, max-pooling, nearest upsampling, one skip)

baselines.colour: a Gaussian per class over red, green and blue; Bayes' rule with the class shares per theme
